query.name: Amoxicillin trials_public
query.vqlShellQuery:
WITH "ct_codes" AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT "bnf_code" AS "bnf_code"
         FROM "pharm_ai"."clinical_trials"
         WHERE "trial_name" = 'Amoxicillin 500mg capsules Trial'
     )
SELECT ROUND(SUM("gp"."actual_cost"), 2) AS "TotalActualCost",
       SUM("gp"."items") AS "TotalItems",
       COUNT(DISTINCT "gp"."practice_code") AS "PracticeCount",
       COUNT(DISTINCT "ct"."bnf_code") AS "BnfCodeCount"
FROM "ct_codes" "ct"
     JOIN "pharm_ai"."fact_gpprescribing_sample" "gp"
         ON "ct"."bnf_code" = "gp"."bnf_code"
